segments.name: IoT
segments.description: The group runs its business as a single reportable segment, selling its products and services or platform and underlying technology to customers.
segments.evidence: Hence, the Group has only one operating segment and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the group for its products and services, and may be required to make advance payments or a deposit before services are rendered.
revenueModel.evidence: The Group assesses the creditworthiness of each customer when providing services and may require the customers to make advance payments or a deposit before the services are rendered.
